## Earlier outstanding worklists

These worklists are source-specific and can overlap. Their old counts have not been revalidated row by row against T38, so do not add them to the 7,856 rows above as a unique total.

- [Earlier supplied-folder acquisition and editing guide](MISSING-MEDIA-ACQUISITION-2026-09-22.md): 16,598 acquisition/final-asset rows and 1,219 other media-work rows at its last audit.
- [27-category draft worklist](MISSING-MEDIA-T35G-8100-2026-09-22.md): 6,600 prepared-media rows (4,200 image, 1,200 audio, 1,200 video) at its last audit.
- [101–150 draft worklist](MISSING-MEDIA-T35I-CARDS-2026-09-22.md): 846 held single-question media rows at its last audit; composite mechanics are a separate blocker.
- [T38 source disposition and full blocker evidence](../output/t38-15000-20260924/b3/PRIVATE-DISPOSITIONS.jsonl).

For each requested asset, keep the source ID and target ID, obtain the exact version and required clip/crop, record rights and source, then review identity, answer exposure and runtime delivery. Media alone does not clear draft editorial or factual blockers.
